title: Structural MRI segmentation with CAT26 and SPM25
description: Audited single-subject structural MRI workflow using CAT26 and SPM25 for tissue segmentation, spatial normalisation, modulation, tissue-volume extraction, quality control, and preparation of grey-matter images for voxel-based morphometry.
notes: Audited portfolio release. Provenance, reported tissue volumes, quality-control metadata, and retained lightweight outputs were reviewed. The complete original CAT derivative set is not archived, so this release does not claim complete numerical regeneration of all CAT outputs from the public repository alone.
